name: accessibility-violation
defect: src/PaywallView.swift dismisses the paywall with a 28×28 icon-only button carrying no accessibilityLabel. VoiceOver announces "button" and the target is below the 44×44 minimum, so the only exit from a modal paywall is unreachable for the users who most need it.
why: The plan already resolves accessibility-specialist to "SKILL + existing auditor", noting the gap is a GATE and not a person. That gate is still unbuilt: the axiom accessibility-auditor is an agent in another plugin, and no script in this repo inspects UI code.
gap: No runnable detector, and this is the class the plan explicitly said needed a gate. The lab records that the gate named in the plan does not yet exist.
